answer: A farm hence pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The lagoon debit happens at intake, shale totals the burned amount, and nectar anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 30 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Honest users pay that once, farms 3 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
